name: ヘルプ・法的情報・退出操作を備えたアカウントメニュー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0103 ヘルプ・法的情報・退出操作を備えたアカウントメニュー.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render a compact, comfortably readable Japanese Lighthouse account/help menu as one flat white vertical component, about 360 px wide and roughly 530-550 px high. No device frame, outer card, decorative background, large blank top/bottom margins, shadows, or gradients. Keep normal readable scale and exact established Meiryo text roles; achieve density by trimming excess blank space and row padding, never by shrinking type. Use about 48 px rows for single-line settings and More actions, about 58 px for two-line help items, consistent 16 px side insets, modest 18-22 px gaps before Help and More, and fine light-gray dividers only where the source shows them. Preserve the open, flat white treatment. Include exactly these 14 visible strings in this order and do not add any text: タイムゾーン; 世界標準時＋8; 支払い方法; その他の設定; ヘルプ; よくある質問; サービスの仕組みや使い方を調べます。; サポートに連絡; 解決したい問題について相談します。; その他; 法的情報; アプリを評価; ログアウト; アプリのバージョン：6.50.0. Headings ヘルプ and その他 are Meiryo Bold 20/28. Main row titles and labels are Meiryo Regular 14/24. The timezone value, two descriptions, and app-version line are Meiryo Regular 12/16 in muted slate. Keep the timezone value right-aligned with a trailing chevron; give the other source menu rows their right chevrons. Recreate source glyphs faithfully rather than using generic substitutes: round outlined clock for timezone; rounded outlined payment card with horizontal stripe; outlined hexagonal settings ring with centered dot; question mark inside an outlined circle for FAQ; lowercase information glyph inside a small outlined square for support; folded-corner document with short lines for legal; five-point outlined star for app rating; and the distinctive leftward exit arrow crossing a doorway outline for sign-out. Use small slate outline glyphs and narrow chevrons with consistent weight. Keep the sign-out glyph and label in restrained Lighthouse forest green as in the Japanese preview. Preserve the source's clear row hierarchy and exact icon silhouettes; avoid oversized icons, oversized row heights, inflated section gaps, invented card surfaces, generic greater-than text, and any extra decoration.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Keep the Japanese preview's restrained forest-green sign-out label/icon to match the Lighthouse adaptation. The action is clearly labeled, so it does not depend on color alone.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION, 2026-10-18: previous candidates were too big and too spacious. This overrides earlier source-spacing and presentation-enlargement instructions. Use compact ordinary UI proportions, content-driven control widths, restrained small radii, tight but readable padding, and little outer presentation whitespace. Preserve exact established Japanese font roles; do not shrink text to manufacture density. Preserve original icon geometry, strokes, states and artwork. Avoid stretching a small standalone utility control across an entire screen. Use the owner-corrected180x28 three-segment control as a density reference only, not a size to force onto unrelated components. Output image pixels are inspection resolution, never intended application CSS size.
reviewNotes: v001 visually reviewed at 360x527 after opening actual-size view; all 14 Japanese strings and source icon silhouettes are present, flat layout compact but legible; candidate review only, native/app acceptance unverified
